what_this_is: The behaviour of the scripted test purchaser, written down so that every agent in a series receives the same purchase word for word. The lines themselves come from section 3 of the worksheet the run keeps. This file holds only what the purchaser says when the agent asks something between the lines, following rules 4 to 8 of the purchaser instruction (document 05). No model is involved: the purchaser is a script.
default_rule: rule 4 of the instruction: whatever the answer, move on to the next line of the list. Every trigger below fires at most once per position, never twice in a row, and only in the positions it names where only_in_positions is given.
end_of_dialogue: after the agent has answered the last line of the worksheet the purchaser sends nothing further

fixed_responses.when: the agent has given the notice about the processing of the customer's data (position 7, before the booking) and asks whether to continue
any_of: would you like me to continue
would you like me to proceed
confirm that you would like to continue
confirm that you would like to proceed

fixed_responses.when: the agent offers a choice of language
the agent asks for documents, a payment or information beyond the legend
fixed_responses.say: I don't have that with me. Please go ahead with what I've already given you.

legend_answers.when: the agent asks a clarifying question that a field of the legend answers; the answer is the field and nothing else

any_of: when would you like to view
when would you like to visit

legend_answers.note: a legend answer is given only when the next scripted line does not belong to the same position (the worksheet's own follow-up line answers the question then), and at most once per field per dialogue; the contact details are otherwise given unprompted in position 7, as the worksheet requires

detection: the last message of the agent is lowercased; a trigger fires when every string in all_of, at least one string in any_of and, where also_any_of is given, at least one string in it occur in the message. Nothing else is interpreted.
